scope: Eight explicitly authored sole-use physical repair bases only. Components/tools and multiple-use crawler/towing alternatives are untouched; no generic terminal-item disposal.

repairs.originalDescription: Recovered broken radio from a voice above the ridge.
repairs.recipeDescription: Replace the damaged detachable lead; the radio itself is repaired, not duplicated.
repairs.incorporationReason: The original radio is repaired by replacing its damaged detachable lead; its body is incorporated into the working radio, not duplicated or discarded.

repairs.originalDescription: The intact cabin shell with a damaged replaceable hatch seal.
repairs.recipeDescription: Replace the documented failed hatch seal.
repairs.incorporationReason: Replacing the failed hatch seal restores this same intact cabin shell; the shell remains physically incorporated in the ascent cabin.

repairs.originalDescription: A complete calibrated weather sensor head on its mast. Its wind vane was detached for storage; temperature and pressure sensors are already protected inside the assembly.
repairs.recipeDescription: Restore the missing wind vane to the complete calibrated sensor mast. The existing sensors need their logger and power connection, not rebuilding.
repairs.incorporationReason: Refitting the detached wind vane completes the existing sensor mast as the weather station; the original mast and protected sensors are incorporated, not duplicated.

repairs.originalDescription: The largely intact site relay. Its service indicator identifies a blown replaceable fuse; its internal filters and wiring are already fitted.
repairs.recipeDescription: Replace the identified blown fuse in the intact relay transceiver. Its internal radio circuits are already assembled.
repairs.incorporationReason: Replacing the identified fuse repairs the same largely intact relay transceiver; its body and assembled radio circuits are incorporated into the working relay.

repairs.originalDescription: A field refuge a short way along the recovery route from the disabled crawler. Its life support is intact, but a documented seam tear needs the pressure patch before the crew can shelter here.
repairs.recipeDescription: Repair the shelter's documented torn outer seam.
repairs.incorporationReason: Patching the documented seam makes this same field shelter the sealed refuge; the shelter and its intact life support remain incorporated in the repaired refuge.

repairs.originalDescription: The crawler’s matched replacement drive module. Inspect it with the toolkit before attaching its coupling.
repairs.recipeDescription: Inspect and service the supplied replacement drive.
repairs.incorporationReason: The inspected and serviced drive is the same supplied replacement module, not a second drive; its original body is incorporated into the serviced drive.

repairs.originalDescription: Recovered greenhouse shell from a meal that grew here.
repairs.recipeDescription: Repair the documented damaged panel seam in the otherwise intact greenhouse.
repairs.incorporationReason: Repairing the damaged panel seam restores this same greenhouse shell; its enclosure remains incorporated into the working greenhouse.

repairs.originalDescription: Recovered electrolyzer stack from the plant that breathes stone air.
repairs.recipeDescription: Restore the recovered solid-oxide oxygen-generation module and its matched controller.
repairs.incorporationReason: Restoring the recovered oxygen-generation module with its matched controller makes the oxygen plant around this same electrolyzer stack; the stack remains physically incorporated in the plant.
